title: The job market's real problem: nobody is hiring #shorts
description:
Microsoft just offered buyouts to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce. So are layoffs really surging? The government's own data tells a very different story.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: Layoffs and discharges, quits, job openings and hires rate (BLS JOLTS: JTSLDL, JTSQUL, JTSJOL, JTSHIR); initial jobless claims (US Dept. of Labor: ICSA); payrolls by industry (BLS: PAYEMS, CES6562000001, MANEMP, USINFO); unemployment (BLS: UNRATE, UNEMPLOY, UEMPMEAN); Sahm rule recession indicator (SAHMREALTIME); Fed funds target (DFEDTARU); retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, through October 2026. Microsoft buyouts: CNBC, TechCrunch, Deadline and Fortune reports, October 26-28, 2026.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script, characters and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
